Napiši sestavek (13–15 povedi) na eno temo: A) My best friend ALI B) My favourite food and meals. Uporabi: be, have got, can, there is/are, some/any, and, but. Na koncu preveri: velike začetnice, pike, he/she has, His.
tasks.solution:
Točkovanje kot pri učiteljici: vsebina 3 (vse zahtevano), slovnica 3 (has got, His, There are, some/any), besedišče in črkovanje 2, povezovanje (and, but, because) in urejenost 2.

Model A: My best friend is Luka. He's eleven years old and he's from Slovenia. He's tall and slim. He's got short brown hair and green eyes. He's got a younger sister. He can play football very well, but he can't swim. His favourite football player is Messi. His favourite food is pizza. He doesn't like fish. There's a good pizzeria near our school. We often go there after school. Luka is funny and friendly. He's a great friend!

Model B: I have breakfast at seven o'clock. I usually have milk and cereal. I have lunch at school at half past twelve. My favourite lunch is chicken with potatoes. In the evening I have dinner with my family. My favourite food is pizza. I don't like celery. There's some milk and a lot of yoghurt in our fridge, but there aren't any sweets. My favourite place to eat is a pizzeria in our town. The pizzas there are delicious!
